wikidot5e:spell:commune.effectSummary: Contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three yes-or-no questions before the 1-minute duration ends. Each receives a correct answer, although information beyond the being's knowledge may produce 'unclear,' and the DM may give a short phrase when a one-word answer would mislead or conflict with the deity's interests. If you cast commune more than once before your next long rest, each casting after the first has a cumulative 25% chance of receiving no answer; the DM rolls secretly.

wikidot5e:spell:commune-with-city.effectSummary: Gain knowledge of the surrounding urban area: within 1 mile aboveground or within 600 feet in sewers and other underground settings. Instantly learn up to three facts you choose concerning terrain and water; prevalent buildings, plants, animals, or intelligent creatures; CR 1+ celestials, fey, fiends, elementals, or undead; planar influences; or electrical currents, wireless signals, and active transit lines or tracks.

wikidot5e:spell:commune-with-nature.effectSummary: Gain knowledge of natural territory within 3 miles outdoors or 300 feet in caves and similar natural underground settings. The spell does not function where construction has replaced nature, such as towns or dungeons. Instantly learn up to three facts you choose concerning terrain and water; prevalent plants, minerals, animals, or peoples; powerful celestials, fey, fiends, elementals, or undead; planar influences; or buildings.

wikidot5e:spell:compelled-duel.effectSummary: One visible creature in range makes a Wisdom save. On a failure, for the duration it has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you and must make a Wisdom save whenever it tries to move to a space more than 30 feet from you; a successful movement save removes that movement restriction for that turn. The spell ends if you attack another creature, cast a spell targeting another hostile creature, a creature friendly to you damages the target or casts a harmful spell on it, or you end your turn more than 30 feet from the target.

wikidot5e:spell:comprehend-languages.effectSummary: For 1 hour you understand the literal meaning of spoken language you hear and written language you see while touching the surface bearing it. Reading takes about 1 minute per page. The spell does not decode secret messages or glyphs that are not themselves part of a written language.

wikidot5e:spell:compulsion.effectSummary: Each creature you choose that is visible in range and can hear you makes a Wisdom save; a creature immune to being charmed automatically succeeds. A failed target is affected for the duration. On each of your turns you can use a bonus action to choose a horizontal direction; on its next turn each affected target must spend as much movement as possible moving that way, although it may take its action before moving. After that forced movement it repeats the Wisdom save, ending the effect on itself on a success. The spell never forces a creature into an obviously deadly hazard, but it can force movement that provokes opportunity attacks.

wikidot5e:spell:cone-of-cold.effectSummary: Each creature in a 60-foot cone makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature killed by this damage becomes a frozen statue until it thaws. Each slot level above 5th adds 1d8 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:confusion.effectSummary: Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered within range make Wisdom saves when you cast; failures cannot take reactions and roll 1d10 at the start of each turn for behavior. On 1, use all movement in a random direction determined with a d8 and take no action. On 2–6, neither move nor act. On 7–8, use the action to make a melee attack against a random creature within reach, doing nothing if none is reachable. On 9–10, move and act normally. At the end of each turn an affected creature repeats the Wisdom save, ending the effect on a success. Each slot level above 4th increases the sphere radius by 5 feet.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-animals.effectSummary: Summon fey spirits in beast form into visible unoccupied spaces in range, choosing one CR 2-or-lower beast, two CR 1-or-lower beasts, four CR 1/2-or-lower beasts, or eight CR 1/4-or-lower beasts. Each is also fey and disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends. They are friendly to you and your companions, share an initiative group with their own turns, and obey your verbal commands without requiring your action. Without commands they defend themselves but otherwise take no actions; the DM supplies their statistics. Using a 5th-level slot doubles the number summoned, a 7th-level slot triples it, and a 9th-level slot quadruples it.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-barlgura.effectSummary: Summon a barlgura in a visible unoccupied space; it disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends. It is hostile to all nondemons and has its own initiative. At the start of each turn it moves toward and attacks the nearest nondemon it can perceive, choosing randomly among equally near targets; if it perceives none, it moves randomly searching for foes. During casting you may draw a circle around your space using the blood of an intelligent humanoid killed within the previous 24 hours. While the spell lasts, the summoned barlgura cannot cross that circle or target anyone inside it.
